items.title: After a slow start, Svi Mykhailiuk picked it up to lead Ukraine over Montenegro.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
After a slow start, Svi Mykhailiuk picked it up to lead Ukraine over Montenegro.

Mykhailiuk had 23 points (5-for-12 3Ps), 6 rebounds, 4 assists, 2 steals, 2 blocks.
